title: Bind signoff approval to integrated evidence
objective: Require signoff decisions to match the current integrated SHA and deterministic signoff packet digest.

milestones.title: Trace the authoritative signoff path
milestones.objective: Identify every transition that can publish or complete a run.
success_criteria: The controller-owned transition path is explicit.

milestones.title: Enforce evidence-bound decisions
milestones.objective: Reject stale SHA, stale packet, and unproved acceptance claims.
success_criteria: Only the current proved integration candidate can advance.

milestones.title: Exercise accepted and rejected shapes
milestones.objective: Run focused state and request validation tests.
success_criteria: Valid approval passes and stale or incomplete requests fail.

non_goals: Do not add automatic merge behavior.
Do not replace behavioral validators with review prose.
success_criteria: Approval checks both the integration SHA and packet digest.
Human rejection routes a file-scoped blocker into remediation.
required_positive_tests: current SHA and packet with complete proof advances to publication readiness
required_evidence: focused state-transition test output bound to the task commit SHA
controller validation records for the integrated head
proof_limits: Local tests do not establish hosted CI or device behavior.
stop_conditions: The signoff state machine is not authoritative.
The repair requires an unowned path.
A required proof source cannot bind to the integrated SHA.
